note: Warriors Wall — IG-style photos athletes send in (racing, being silly, with friends). Athletes submit via the form on the home page (caption + name/handle + consent land on their lead record as kind 'wall_photo'; the photo itself arrives on WhatsApp/email). Dina adds a row here once she has the photo and their OK — nothing goes up unmoderated. Newest first. 'src' = path under /roxjaya/images/gallery/ (JPG, max ~1600px wide). 'caption' = the athlete's own words, verbatim. 'by' = name or @handle. 'event' = the event the photo belongs to (e.g. 'Hyrox Jakarta 2026', 'Squad sessions') — the wall groups photos by it, newest event first. 'tilt' optional degrees (-6..6), random if omitted. Empty list hides the section.
